title: Weapon Supremacy
description: The higher tier of weapon specialisation from Wretched Hives, taken later in a character's career and covering the same eight weapon groups as weapon focus. It is a type of its own rather than a tier inside weapon-focus for the same reason fighting masteries are separate from fighting styles: the two are granted by different features, appear in different lists, and a character can hold either without the other. The shape is identical, which is deliberate — a reader comparing Blade Focus with Blade Supremacy should be comparing like with like.

key.description: Stable slug identifying this supremacy. Derived from the name once and never reused, so saved characters keep resolving after a rename.

name.description: Display name as printed: Blade Supremacy, Crushing Weapon Supremacy, Trip Weapon Supremacy. As with the focuses, whether the word "Weapon" appears varies by group, so the name is reproduced rather than generated.

weaponGroup.description: The group of weapons the supremacy applies to, using the same eight values as weapon focus so the pair of a group's entries can be read side by side.

description.description: The sentence that opens the entry, saying what the character has specialised in and under what condition the benefits apply, ending at the colon that introduces them.

benefits.description: The concrete rules the supremacy grants while wielding a weapon of its group, one entry per bullet as printed, in the printed order.

sourceKey.description: Key of the source this supremacy was published in, matching a document of the source content type. Every weapon supremacy in the archive is wh.

contentSet.description: Whether this supremacy belongs to the core rules or to the community expanded-content supplement.
